scope: Restore Publish 14.1 passive racial skill modifiers for all ten playable species while preserving the project rule that corpse harvesting requires Novice Scout and preserving the current default command, certification, schematic, quest, conversation, and zone surfaces.

findings: Two independent preserved PRE-CU skill tables and the authenticated project reference agree on the passive modifier sets and values for all ten playable species.

The current x64 DX11 client skill-box data independently carries the racial bonus values, including Zabrak anti_shock, Wookiee tame_bonus, and Human leadership; its Bothan display helper labels the canonical server take_cover modifier as cover.
The retained server runtime consumes leadership in squad-leader calculations and tame_bonus in creature-taming calculations; all skill modifiers remain native skill-statistic inputs.
The historical Trandoshan and Sullustan creature_harvesting bonuses are intentionally omitted under the project rule that Novice Scout exclusively grants corpse harvesting.
